intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and luxury on the water.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant, untouched coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the Maldives' most pristine reef sites by speedboat, with snorkeling gear, a marine biologist guide, and a light seafood lunch served on a sandbank included.
experiences.location: Hanifaru Bay, Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in an all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a curated five-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian lobster, sashimi-grade tuna, and locally inspired desserts while colorful fish and rays glide past your table. An unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime romantic dinner experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll (Conrad Maldives Rangali Island)

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Step ashore on a local inhabited island to discover authentic Maldivian culture. Visit a traditional fishing village, a historic coral-stone mosque, and a local school. Then join a hands-on cooking class with a local family to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and roshi flatbread using fresh island ingredients.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature two-hour couples' spa journey performed in an overwater treatment pavilion with direct ocean views and a glass floor panel. The ritual includes a coconut oil body scrub, a hot stone massage, and a floral bath drawn in your private plunge pool overlooking the lagoon — the ultimate luxury honeymoon pampering experience.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then arrange a budget speedboat or public ferry transfer to your island. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Maldives (Beachfront room). Freshen up, unpack, and take a leisurely stroll along the beachfront to get oriented with the resort and surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach — completely free and breathtaking. Explore the resort grounds and nearby local area. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's most affordable dining option or a nearby local café.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a quick snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Quick affordable bite at the airport or ferry terminal — local short eats (hedhikaa) like fish rolls and samosas for under $5
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's budget-friendly restaurant or a local island café — try mas riha (fish curry) with roshi (flatbread) for $8–$12

day_by_day.notes: Exchange some USD to MVR at the airport for local purchases. Public ferries are significantly cheaper than private speedboats — check schedules in advance. Keep receipts for all transfers for budget tracking.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise beach walk along your beachfront. After breakfast, rent a snorkel set from the resort or a local dive shop (budget $5–$10/day rental) and head to the nearest house reef for a morning snorkeling session. Spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations right off the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local island on foot or by bicycle (rent for $3–$5/hour). Visit the island's local market to browse fresh produce, handicrafts, and souvenirs. Stop by the island's mosque and public beach areas to experience authentic Maldivian culture.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachfront sunset session — bring a local snack and enjoy the colors over the Indian Ocean. After dark, try stargazing from the beach (Maldives has minimal light pollution). Enjoy a candlelit dinner at a budget local restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet if included, or local tea shop — roshi with tuna paste and black tea for $3–$5
meals.lunch: Local island café — garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice and lime for $5–$7
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — grilled fish with coconut rice and salad for $10–$15

day_by_day.notes: House reef snorkeling is free if you own or rent gear. Always snorkel with a buddy. Check resort notice boards for any free or low-cost activities scheduled for guests.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group snorkeling trip organized by a local dive center (approx $25–$40 per person). Visit 2–3 snorkeling spots including coral gardens and a manta ray or shark-watching site. These group tours are far cheaper than private charters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Relax on your private beachfront and read, nap, or simply enjoy the turquoise lagoon. Take a swim in the shallow lagoon — ideal for romantic wading and floating together.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a DIY romantic beach picnic — buy fresh fruit, local snacks, and drinks from the island shop (budget $10–$15 total). Lay a sarong on the beach and enjoy the stars and ocean breeze. Perfect honeymoon-style evening without the resort markup.

meals.breakfast: Local tea house — fried yams, fish cakes, and sweet tea for $4
meals.lunch: Pack a simple lunch from local shop before the snorkel trip — tuna sandwiches and coconut water for $5
meals.dinner: Beach picnic with local fruits (papaya, watermelon), chips, and soft drinks — $10–$15 total

day_by_day.notes: Book group snorkeling tours at least a day in advance. Bring reef-safe sunscreen (required in Maldives to protect coral). A waterproof phone pouch ($5–$8) is a great investment for underwater photos.

day_by_day.morning: Take a public ferry to a neighboring local island for a day trip (ferry costs $1–$3 each way). Explore the island's streets, visit the local school area, and interact with friendly residents. This gives an authentic glimpse into real Maldivian life beyond the resort bubble.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel off the neighboring island's public beach or sandbank. Many local islands have accessible house reefs with excellent marine life. Look for nudibranch, octopus, and reef sharks in shallow waters.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your home island by late afternoon ferry. Shower and dress up for a slightly more special dinner — treat yourselves to one mid-range meal at the resort restaurant as a honeymoon splurge (budget $30–$40 for two).

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at resort or local café before ferry departure — $4–$6
meals.lunch: Local island restaurant on the neighboring island — fresh fish curry and rice for $6–$8 per person
meals.dinner: Semi-splurge dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant — grilled seafood platter for two with mocktails — $30–$40 total

day_by_day.notes: Check public ferry schedules the day before — they run on fixed timetables and may be infrequent. Dress modestly when visiting local islands (cover shoulders and knees out of respect for Islamic culture). Carry a small day bag with water, sunscreen, and snorkel gear.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide — marine life is most active in the early morning hours. Look for hawksbill sea turtles feeding on the reef. Spend 1.5–2 hours in the water before the sun gets too intense.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon relaxing at the resort's beachfront. Enjoy the free beach amenities — sun loungers, beach volleyball, and swimming. This is a perfect low-cost, high-enjoyment afternoon. Read, nap, or take photos of your beautiful surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Walk to the local island's western tip for sunset watching — a popular free activity. After sunset, browse local craft shops for affordable souvenirs like shell jewelry, woven baskets, and lacquerware. Budget $10–$20 for small keepsakes.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local tea shop — $3–$6
meals.lunch: Simple self-catered lunch — buy fresh coconuts ($1 each), local snacks, and fruit from the island shop — $6–$8
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant — tuna curry, rice, and papadum for $8–$10 per person

day_by_day.notes: Turtles are most commonly seen in the early morning. Never touch or chase turtles — observe from a respectful distance. Free beach activities significantly reduce daily costs — take full advantage of them.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget dolphin-watching sunrise cruise (group tour approx $20–$30 per person). Spinner dolphins are commonly seen in Maldivian waters in the early morning. The cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and is a magical, romantic experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby sandbank by local dhoni boat (arrange through a local guesthouse or tour operator — $15–$25 per person for a group trip). Spend 2 hours on a pristine white sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise water — the quintessential Maldives experience.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening stroll along the beach hand-in-hand. Look for bioluminescent plankton glowing in the waves after dark (most visible on moonless nights). Enjoy a quiet dinner at a local restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the dolphin cruise — local bakery items and tea for $3–$4
meals.lunch: Pack snacks for the sandbank trip — buy from local shop the night before — $5–$7
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — mas huni (shredded tuna with coconut) with roshi and fresh juice for $8–$12

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton is most visible between June and November but can occasionally be seen in March. Check with locals about recent sightings. Sandbank trips are best in the morning before winds pick up. Bring waterproof sandals for the sandbank.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recharge morning — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Spend the morning in the calm lagoon, floating and swimming. Practice snorkeling skills or simply enjoy the peaceful turquoise water. This is your halfway point — a perfect day to slow down.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the island's local community center or cultural space if available. Learn about Maldivian traditions, bodu beru drumming culture, and island life. Alternatively, take a free self-guided walking tour of the entire island (most local islands take under an hour to walk around).
day_by_day.evening: Cook or assemble a simple romantic dinner using items from the local shop — fresh bread, canned tuna, local fruits, and drinks. Eat on your beachfront with candles if available. This is your most budget-friendly romantic dinner of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort or café breakfast — $4–$7
meals.lunch: Local tea shop — short eats platter (assorted Maldivian snacks) for $4–$6
meals.dinner: Self-assembled beachfront dinner from local shop — bread, spreads, fruits, and drinks for $8–$12 for two

day_by_day.notes: Halfway through the trip — take stock of your budget and adjust spending for the remaining days. Rest days are essential to avoid burnout. Check your snorkel gear for any damage and return/renew rental if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group diving intro session or snorkeling trip to a deeper reef or shipwreck site (if available near your island — approx $30–$50 per person for intro dive, $20–$30 for snorkeling). Shipwrecks and outer reefs host larger marine life including reef sharks, eagle rays, and barracuda.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon on the beach. This is a great time for underwater photography using your waterproof phone pouch. Review and edit photos from the trip so far. Alternatively, enjoy a long swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for a romantic beach walk at sunset. Find a quiet stretch of beach away from other guests for private couple time. After dark, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant and share stories from the week.

meals.breakfast: Local café — roshi, egg, and tea for $4
meals.lunch: Quick local meal post-dive — fish soup and rice for $6–$8
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — lobster or reef fish (when in season and budget allows) for $15–$20 per person as a mid-trip treat

day_by_day.notes: If budget is tight, skip the dive and do a snorkeling-only trip. Outer reef snorkeling still offers incredible visibility and marine life. Drink plenty of water after diving or extended snorkeling to stay hydrated in the tropical heat.

day_by_day.morning: Take a public ferry or arrange a budget group day trip to Male (the capital city) if within reasonable distance. Explore the colorful streets, visit the Grand Friday Mosque (Masjid al-Sultan Muhammad Thakurufaanu Al Auzam), the fish market, and the local bazaar area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Male — visit the National Museum (entry approx $3–$5) to learn about Maldivian history and culture. Browse the local market for affordable souvenirs — woven mats, lacquerware, and dried fish products make unique gifts. Head back to your island by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening after a busy day of sightseeing. Enjoy a quiet dinner and early night. Share your favorite photos and memories from the Male trip.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before departure — local café $3–$5
meals.lunch: Male fish market area — fresh tuna sandwiches and local short eats for $5–$7
meals.dinner: Local restaurant back on your island — simple fish curry dinner for $8–$12

day_by_day.notes: Male is very walkable — most attractions are within easy walking distance of each other. Dress modestly in Male (conservative Islamic city). The fish market is most active in the early morning. Keep valuables secure in the busy market areas.

day_by_day.morning: Final dedicated snorkeling morning — revisit your favorite snorkel spot or try a new section of the house reef. Spend extra time observing marine life you may have missed earlier in the trip. This is your last chance for extended underwater exploration.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a slow afternoon at the beach — swimming, sunbathing, and reading. Take time to write postcards or journal entries about your honeymoon experience. Visit the resort's beachfront area and take professional-quality photos of each other with the stunning backdrop.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a budget-friendly romantic evening — buy a bottle of local juice or sparkling water, find a quiet beach spot, and watch the sunset together. Reflect on your honeymoon so far. Enjoy dinner at your favorite local restaurant discovered during the trip.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local café — $4–$7
meals.lunch: Beach picnic from local shop — $8–$10
meals.dinner: Return to your favorite local restaurant of the trip — budget $12–$18 per person

day_by_day.notes: Start thinking about souvenirs and gifts to bring home — local shops are cheapest. Begin packing non-essential items to make final departure day easier. Check resort checkout procedures and any outstanding bills.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise swim in the lagoon — one of the most peaceful and romantic experiences of the trip. After breakfast, take a final bicycle tour around the island, stopping at all your favorite spots for last photos. Visit the beach where you watched your first Maldivian sunset.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon doing any remaining souvenir shopping at local craft shops. Visit the local community area and thank any friendly locals you've met during your stay. Pack souvenirs carefully to avoid damage during travel.
day_by_day.evening: Pre-farewell dinner — choose a slightly nicer local restaurant for a memorable penultimate evening. Share your favorite memories of the trip over dinner. Take an evening beach walk and collect a small shell or piece of coral (dead, not live) as a keepsake.

meals.breakfast: Local tea shop — final local breakfast experience for $4–$5
meals.lunch: Light lunch from local shop — $5–$7
meals.dinner: Nicer local restaurant — fresh grilled fish, coconut curry, and dessert for $15–$20 per person

day_by_day.notes: Only collect dead shell fragments from the beach — removing live coral or shells is illegal in Maldives and carries heavy fines. Start consolidating luggage and confirm ferry/speedboat transfer for departure day. Check flight details and airport transfer timings.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkel session — say goodbye to the reef, the fish, and the turtles. Spend one last hour in the crystal-clear water. Return to the resort, shower, and begin final packing. Check out procedures if leaving today or prepare for last night.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the last full afternoon on the beach — no agenda, just pure relaxation. Take a final swim in the lagoon. Sit in the shallow water and absorb the beauty of the Maldives one last time. Take a final set of beach photos.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner — treat yourselves to the best affordable meal of the trip. Choose fresh seafood, coconut-based Maldivian dishes, and a special dessert. Toast to your honeymoon with fresh coconut or tropical juice. Watch the final sunset of your Maldives trip.

meals.breakfast: Resort or local café — $4–$7
meals.lunch: Light local lunch — $6–$8
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the best local restaurant or resort — grilled seafood, rice, curry, and dessert for $20–$30 for two as a final splurge

day_by_day.notes: Confirm all checkout details, outstanding bills, and transport arrangements for departure day. Set an early alarm if the transfer requires an early start. Leave a positive review for local restaurants and guesthouses that provided great service.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Complete checkout from Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange transfer to the ferry terminal or speedboat jetty for transport to Velana International Airport. Allow ample time for the journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport. Complete check-in and security procedures. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts (dried tuna, Maldivian honey, or local crafts). Enjoy a final Maldivian meal at the airport before departure.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight and reflect on 13 incredible days in the Maldives. Review your photos, relive your favorite memories, and start planning your next adventure together.

meals.breakfast: Quick early breakfast at resort or pack snacks from local shop the night before — $3–$5
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — budget $10–$15 per person
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3–4 hours before flight departure for island-to-airport transfer plus airport procedures. Keep all important documents (passport, boarding pass, travel insurance) easily accessible. Currency: spend remaining MVR at the airport as it's hard to exchange abroad. Safe travels!

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs. Meet resort transfer representative and board a scenic speedboat or seaplane transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, receive a welcome drink, and settle in. Take a leisurely stroll along the beach to get familiar with the resort grounds.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Enjoy a romantic welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant — a perfect introduction to the island atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the plane or grab a light snack at Malé Airport before transfer
meals.lunch: Light bites or snacks available at the resort upon arrival — try the resort's casual beach café for a sandwich and fresh juice
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — opt for the set dinner menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and local curries (mid-range set menu)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 relaxed to recover from travel. Confirm all upcoming excursion bookings with the resort concierge this evening. Request a beachfront or ocean-facing table for dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Start with a leisurely resort breakfast overlooking the ocean. After breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for a guided introductory snorkeling session. Explore the colorful reef fish, coral formations, and perhaps spot a sea turtle right from the shore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on your private beachfront stretch with a good book and cocktails from the beach bar. In the mid-afternoon, visit the resort spa for a consultation and book your couples' spa ritual for later in the trip. Take a refreshing swim in the resort infinity pool.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, sipping champagne as the sun melts into the horizon.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs, pastries, and local Maldivian short eats like mas huni (tuna with coconut)
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at the resort beach bar — grilled fish tacos, fresh salads, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Return from the sunset cruise and dine at the resort's à la carte seafood grill — grilled lobster or catch of the day with a bottle of house wine

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours. Bring a light wrap for the sea breeze. Confirm booking with concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: After breakfast, embark on the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — a guided half-day excursion exploring vibrant, untouched coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. Equipment provided; underwater cameras available for hire.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a light lunch. Spend the afternoon at leisure — try stand-up paddleboarding or kayaking offered by the resort's water sports center. Explore the shallow lagoon around your beachfront villa.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachfront dinner under the stars — arrange with the resort for a private table set on the sand with lanterns and flowers for a special touch.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before the snorkeling safari — yogurt, fruit, and coffee
meals.lunch: Fresh fish wraps and tropical fruit smoothies at the resort beach café upon return from safari
meals.dinner: Private beachside candlelit dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — a curated two-course set menu with fresh grilled fish, coconut rice, and a shared dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen before the snorkeling safari — the resort may provide complimentary reef-safe sunscreen. Bring a change of clothes and a dry bag for valuables.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Order in-room breakfast and enjoy it on your beachfront terrace. Take a morning yoga session offered by the resort (usually complimentary or low-cost) on the beach at sunrise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby sandbank by resort boat — a pristine white sandbar surrounded by crystal-clear water perfect for swimming, photography, and pure relaxation. Many resorts arrange complimentary sandbank picnics.
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in the Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual — a signature two-hour couples' spa journey performed in an overwater treatment pavilion with ocean views, featuring massages, scrubs, and aromatherapy.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast on the beachfront terrace — continental spread with fresh juices, croissants, and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch arranged by the resort — fresh sandwiches, fruit, cold beverages, and local snacks
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant — sushi, tempura, and wok-fried noodles with fresh Maldivian seafood; pair with a glass of sake or local mocktail

day_by_day.notes: Book the sandbank excursion and couples' spa ritual in advance through the resort concierge. The spa ritual is best enjoyed in the late afternoon when light is golden.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour and Cooking Class — take a short boat ride to a local inhabited island and discover authentic Maldivian culture. Visit a traditional mosque, local school, and artisan workshops. Learn about the island's history and way of life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cooking class portion of the tour — learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (fish curry), and bis keemiya (local pastry). Enjoy what you cook for lunch.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Wind down with a cocktail at the overwater bar. Enjoy a casual dinner at the resort, reflecting on the cultural experiences of the day.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet before departing for the cultural tour
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian meal prepared during the cooking class on the local island — an authentic and memorable dining experience included in the tour
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the Maldivian-inspired curry of the day in honor of the cooking class, with roshi (flatbread)

day_by_day.notes: Dress respectfully for the local island visit — cover shoulders and knees. Bring cash (Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD) for purchasing local handicrafts and souvenirs.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at the resort's house reef — go at your own pace and explore the underwater world at leisure. Look for octopus, moray eels, and colorful parrotfish in the coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a resort-arranged dolphin watching cruise in the afternoon — the Indian Ocean is home to spinner dolphins that frequently delight visitors with acrobatic displays.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two — dine in an all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean, with a curated five-course tasting menu and wine pairings. A truly magical and unforgettable honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet — enjoy a full spread before your active morning
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort beach bar — fish and chips or a fresh ceviche with lime and coconut
meals.dinner: Five-course tasting menu at the Underwater Restaurant — fresh ocean seafood, premium ingredients, and sommelier-selected wine pairings in a breathtaking setting

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant Dinner is a premium experience — book well in advance as it is extremely popular. Smart casual dress code applies. This is the highlight dining experience of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day — sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Take a long walk along the beach collecting shells. Spend time journaling or reading in a hammock between palm trees.
day_by_day.afternoon: Try a new water sport — opt for windsurfing, jet skiing, or a fun banana boat ride offered by the resort's water sports center. Alternatively, take a beginner's scuba diving discover session in the resort's calm lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar. Enjoy the view as the sky turns shades of pink and orange. Follow with a romantic dinner for two.

meals.breakfast: Late brunch at the resort — eggs benedict, smoked fish, fresh fruit platters, and freshly squeezed juices
meals.lunch: Skip a formal lunch or grab light snacks at the beach bar — fresh coconut, fruit skewers, and a cold mocktail
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant — wood-fired pizza, pasta with seafood, and a shared tiramisu for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Midway point of the trip — take stock of remaining bookings and confirm any pending excursions with the concierge. This is a great day to purchase any local souvenirs from the resort boutique.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning guided birdwatching and nature walk around the resort island — spot migratory birds, hermit crabs, and lush tropical vegetation. A peaceful and grounding start to the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with a swim-up bar. Order a few signature cocktails and enjoy the panoramic ocean views. Try the resort's signature mocktail menu if avoiding alcohol.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne for a different route and sunset perspective — or if already done twice, arrange a private beachside fire pit evening with the resort for a romantic stargazing session.

meals.breakfast: Light healthy breakfast before the nature walk — granola, yogurt, and fresh tropical juices
meals.lunch: Pool bar lunch — gourmet burgers, sweet potato fries, and frozen cocktails by the infinity pool
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — opt for the chef's special of the day, usually a fresh catch prepared with local spices and served with coconut rice

day_by_day.notes: Request the stargazing or fire pit setup from the resort concierge at least 24 hours in advance. The Maldives has exceptional stargazing conditions away from city light pollution.

day_by_day.morning: Join a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari at a different site — explore a new reef system with different marine biodiversity, including a potential night snorkeling option at some resorts for bioluminescent plankton.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a couples' relaxation session — use the resort's jacuzzi, steam room, or sauna facilities. Take a leisurely nap in a shaded beach daybed.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a casual themed dinner night at the resort — many Maldivian resorts host weekly BBQ nights or Maldivian cultural nights with live music and traditional boduberu drumming performances.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort before the morning snorkeling excursion
meals.lunch: Fresh grilled fish and salad at the resort beach café — light and refreshing after a morning in the water
meals.dinner: Resort BBQ night or Maldivian cultural dinner — grilled seafood, local curries, and tropical desserts accompanied by traditional music and dance performances

day_by_day.notes: Check with the resort for their weekly event schedule to align this evening with any cultural performances or themed nights. A wonderful and lively way to experience Maldivian hospitality.

day_by_day.morning: Morning at leisure — enjoy a slow breakfast and take a final swim at the house reef. Try underwater photography with a rented or purchased waterproof camera to capture your favorite marine memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's wellness center for individual treatments — a deep tissue massage, a Maldivian coconut oil treatment, or a rejuvenating facial. Spend the remaining afternoon journaling or reading on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private in-villa romantic dinner — the resort can set up a beautifully decorated table on your beachfront terrace with candles, flowers, and a personalized menu. A deeply intimate honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — take your time and try everything on the buffet you haven't yet
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's casual café — avocado toast, fresh fruit bowl, and iced coffee
meals.dinner: Private in-villa or beachfront dinner — personalized three-course menu arranged with the resort chef; typically includes a starter, main course with fresh seafood, and a romantic dessert with a surprise element for honeymooners

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance if celebrating an anniversary or honeymoon milestone — they often add complimentary touches such as flower arrangements, a cake, or a personalized message.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session — revisit your favorite reef spot for one last immersive underwater experience. Take mental snapshots of the marine life and coral colors to carry home.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a relaxed afternoon doing resort activities of your choice — beach volleyball, paddleboarding, or simply lounging. Visit the resort boutique for last-minute souvenir shopping — local crafts, lacquerware, and Maldivian jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the overwater bar followed by a special farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — celebrate the last full evening of your honeymoon in style.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet — indulge in all your favorites one more time
meals.lunch: Beach bar lunch — fresh fish sandwich, tropical fruit smoothie, and coconut pudding
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's signature fine dining restaurant — a curated tasting menu with wine pairings, celebrating the end of a perfect honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing non-essentials this evening. Confirm departure transfer details with the resort concierge — speedboat or seaplane timing back to Malé for your departure flight.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise together. Take a morning swim or simply sit on the beach with a coffee and absorb the beauty of your surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Board the transfer speedboat or seaplane back to Malé. Explore Malé briefly if time allows — visit the colorful Malé Fish Market, the historic Hukuru Miskiy mosque, and the local street food scene.
day_by_day.evening: If your flight departs late, enjoy dinner in Malé at a local restaurant. Alternatively, relax at the airport lounge before your departure. Reflect on an unforgettable 13-day Maldivian honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a leisurely and nostalgic last meal at Aegean Bliss Resort
meals.lunch: Local lunch in Malé if time permits — try a local café for hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats), samosas, and sweet tea
meals.dinner: Dinner at a mid-range restaurant in Malé or at the airport — fresh tuna dishes are a Maldivian specialty worth trying one final time

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight for airport check-in and security. Malé airport has a good selection of duty-free shops for last-minute purchases. Keep all important documents easily accessible.

day_by_day.morning: Departure day — if your flight is in the morning, enjoy a final coffee at the airport and board your flight home. If there is a long layover, rest and reflect on the incredible memories made across 13 days in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: In-flight or in transit — organize your photos, write a travel journal entry, or simply rest and recharge after an extraordinary honeymoon adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home carrying memories of turquoise waters, vibrant coral gardens, romantic sunsets, and the warmth of Maldivian hospitality — a honeymoon to last a lifetime.

meals.breakfast: Airport breakfast or in-flight meal
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or airport layover dining
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or home arrival dinner

day_by_day.notes: Keep a digital and physical backup of all travel documents, receipts, and experience certificates. Consider writing a review for Aegean Bliss Resort and the experience providers to help future travelers. Welcome home!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and luxury on the water.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant, untouched coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the Maldives' most pristine reef sites by speedboat, with snorkeling gear, a marine biologist guide, and a light seafood lunch served on a sandbank included.
experiences.location: Hanifaru Bay, Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in an all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a curated five-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian lobster, sashimi-grade tuna, and locally inspired desserts while colorful fish and rays glide past your table. An unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime romantic dinner experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll (Conrad Maldives Rangali Island)

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Step ashore on a local inhabited island to discover authentic Maldivian culture. Visit a traditional fishing village, a historic coral-stone mosque, and a local school. Then join a hands-on cooking class with a local family to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and roshi flatbread using fresh island ingredients.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature two-hour couples' spa journey performed in an overwater treatment pavilion with direct ocean views and a glass floor panel. The ritual includes a coconut oil body scrub, a hot stone massage, and a floral bath drawn in your private plunge pool overlooking the lagoon — the ultimate luxury honeymoon pampering experience.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrival at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Meet your dedicated resort butler for a private seaplane or luxury speedboat transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy welcome Champagne and chilled towels on arrival. Check into your Beachfront villa, receive a full resort orientation, and settle in with a private butler briefing on your personalized itinerary.
day_by_day.evening: Leisurely sunset stroll along the private beach as the sky turns amber and rose. Enjoy a welcome cocktail at the overwater bar with panoramic Indian Ocean views. Romantic candlelit dinner on your villa's private terrace, specially arranged by the resort as a honeymoon welcome experience.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Light welcome refreshments and tropical fruit platter served upon villa arrival, courtesy of the resort
meals.dinner: Private candlelit dinner on your beachfront villa terrace — a curated honeymoon welcome menu featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, lobster thermidor, and a complimentary bottle of Moët & Chandon

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance of your honeymoon status for complimentary romantic touches such as rose petal turndown, honeymoon cake, and villa decoration. Keep the first evening relaxed to recover from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up to a floating breakfast delivered to your villa's private pool or lagoon deck — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs Benedict, fresh juices, and Champagne. Afterward, take a gentle guided snorkeling session at the resort's house reef, led by a marine biologist who will introduce you to the resident reef fish, corals, and sea turtles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — embark on a private boat excursion to explore vibrant, untouched coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. Your expert guide will ensure the most breathtaking underwater encounters in the area.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the villa for a relaxing shower and pre-dinner Champagne on the deck. Dine at the resort's signature fine-dining overwater restaurant, enjoying fresh Maldivian and international cuisine with the sound of the ocean beneath you.

meals.breakfast: Floating breakfast delivered to your villa — tropical fruits, Champagne, eggs Benedict, fresh pastries, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch at the resort's beach club — grilled fish tacos, ceviche, fresh coconut, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Signature overwater fine-dining restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — six-course tasting menu featuring local lobster, tuna tartare, and Maldivian-inspired desserts with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari early in the morning upon check-in to secure your preferred time slot. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and underwater camera for the snorkeling excursion.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely in-villa breakfast on your private deck overlooking the lagoon. Spend the late morning at the resort's infinity pool with personalized poolside service — chilled towels, fresh fruit skewers, and premium cocktails delivered to your sun lounger.
day_by_day.afternoon: Overwater Bungalow Couples Spa Ritual — indulge in a signature two-hour couples' spa journey performed in an overwater treatment pavilion with glass floors revealing the turquoise ocean below. Enjoy synchronized massages, aromatic body wraps, floral baths, and a private meditation session with the sound of the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered exclusively for the two of you. Sip vintage Champagne, enjoy a curated canapé selection, and watch the sun melt into the horizon in complete privacy.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast on the deck — Eggs royale, acai bowls, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit platters, and freshly brewed Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Light poolside dining — sushi platter, lobster rolls, fresh coconut water, and artisanal lemonades
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner at the resort's beach grill restaurant — wood-fired whole lobster, grilled Maldivian snapper, and a shared chocolate fondant dessert under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The couples' spa ritual should be booked at least 24 hours in advance. Request the sunset time slot for the dhoni cruise (typically 17:30–19:30) for the most spectacular light. This is an ideal day for romantic photography.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching excursion — board a private speedboat at sunrise to seek out spinner dolphins in their natural habitat as they leap and play in the open ocean. Return for a hearty late breakfast at the villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — step ashore on a nearby local inhabited island to discover authentic Maldivian culture. Visit a traditional village, a historic mosque, and a local school. Then join a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as mas huni, garudhiya fish soup, and coconut-based curries.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a private stargazing experience on the beach, arranged by the resort's astronomy guide with a high-powered telescope. Sip aged rum cocktails and identify constellations in the unpolluted Maldivian night sky.

meals.breakfast: Late in-villa breakfast after dolphin watching — Maldivian-style roshi flatbread with tuna curry, tropical fruit, and freshly brewed tea
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch on the local island during the cooking class — freshly prepared mas huni, coconut flatbread, and tropical fruit
meals.dinner: Romantic beachside dinner at the resort's private sandbank setup — a specially arranged four-course dinner with lanterns, a personal chef, and a sommelier under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The cultural village tour is a wonderful way to connect with local Maldivian heritage beyond the resort. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (covered shoulders and knees). The private sandbank dinner must be booked 48 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the overwater deck with a private instructor — a deeply calming and romantic experience as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Follow with a healthy smoothie bowl breakfast at the resort's wellness café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dinner preparation day — spend the afternoon at leisure. Enjoy kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding on the calm lagoon, then indulge in a private jacuzzi session at the villa with Champagne and chocolate-dipped strawberries.
day_by_day.evening: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two — dine in the resort's all-glass underwater restaurant surrounded by the living ocean. Enjoy a curated five-course gourmet dinner as manta rays, reef sharks, and tropical fish glide gracefully around your table. An extraordinary and unforgettable romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the resort's health café — acai smoothie bowls, avocado toast, green juices, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Overwater brasserie — light Mediterranean-Maldivian fusion menu with fresh sashimi, lobster bisque, and tropical sorbets
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — five-course tasting menu with premium wine pairing: amuse-bouche, chilled seafood medley, pan-seared barramundi, wagyu beef tenderloin, and a signature ocean-blue dessert

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is one of the most sought-after experiences in the Maldives — book as early as possible, ideally at check-in. Request a central table for the best panoramic underwater views. Smart casual dress code applies.

day_by_day.morning: Full relaxation morning — sleep in, enjoy a champagne breakfast in bed, and spend time reading or lounging in your private villa pool. Let the tranquility of the Maldives wash over you completely.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided big game fishing excursion on a luxury chartered vessel — try your hand at deep-sea fishing for yellowfin tuna, barracuda, and wahoo with an experienced local captain. Catch-and-release options are available for conservation-conscious guests.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and have your catch prepared by the resort's executive chef as a bespoke private dinner on your villa terrace — a truly farm-to-table (ocean-to-table) experience. Pair with a curated wine selection chosen by the resort's sommelier.

meals.breakfast: Champagne breakfast in bed — smoked salmon bagels, fresh berries, pastries, sparkling wine, and freshly squeezed juices
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the fishing vessel — gourmet sandwiches, fresh tropical fruits, chilled beverages, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Personalized ocean-to-table dinner on your villa terrace — your catch of the day prepared by the executive chef with sides of truffle risotto, grilled vegetables, and a decadent chocolate lava cake for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort chef of your fishing excursion plans the evening before so they can prepare for a customized cooking experience with your catch. If fishing is not of interest, substitute with a private lagoon snorkeling session or a beach photography session.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip relaxation day — enjoy a slow morning with an elaborate floating breakfast in your villa's private pool. Spend time on the beach collecting shells, walking hand in hand at the shoreline, and simply enjoying the paradise around you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in individual spa treatments at the resort's overwater spa — choose from hot stone massages, deep-tissue therapy, or a Maldivian coconut oil ritual. Afterward, enjoy afternoon tea at the resort's lounge with panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Cocktail masterclass for two — join the resort's head mixologist for a private session learning to craft classic and Maldivian-inspired cocktails. Enjoy your creations as the sun sets, then dine at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Floating pool breakfast — tropical fruit platters, Champagne, smoked salmon crepes, fresh pastries, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Beachside tapas at the resort's casual beach bar — bruschetta, charcuterie boards, fresh ceviche, and tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Resort's Asian fusion restaurant — omakase-style menu featuring fresh sashimi, black truffle gyoza, miso-glazed black cod, and yuzu sorbet with premium sake pairing

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 marks the halfway point of the trip — a perfect time to slow down and simply enjoy the resort's world-class amenities without any structured excursions. Let spontaneity guide the day.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise snorkeling at the house reef — the early morning hours offer the calmest waters and best visibility. Spot sleeping nurse sharks, eagle rays gliding through the shallows, and vibrant coral formations bathed in golden morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private sandbank picnic — the resort arranges a romantic picnic on a secluded, uninhabited sandbank accessible only by boat. Arrive to find a beautifully decorated setup with cushions, a parasol, gourmet picnic hamper, chilled Champagne, and a personal butler on standby.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescence night swim — after dark, wade into the shallows of the resort's beach to witness the magical phenomenon of glowing bioluminescent plankton lighting up the water around your feet. A truly otherworldly and romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Quick pre-snorkeling breakfast — energy bars, fresh fruit, yogurt, and green tea at the resort's wellness station
meals.lunch: Gourmet sandbank picnic — charcuterie, artisan cheeses, lobster rolls, tropical fruit, macarons, and vintage Champagne
meals.dinner: Resort's main restaurant — a la carte dinner featuring pan-seared duck breast, beetroot risotto, fresh Maldivian lobster, and a shared crème brûlée with a glass of vintage port

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescence is best observed on darker nights away from artificial light. Ask the resort's marine team about current plankton activity upon arrival. The sandbank picnic requires 48 hours advance booking.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided manta ray snorkeling excursion — board a private boat to a renowned manta ray cleaning station in the atoll. Snorkel alongside these majestic gentle giants as they glide effortlessly through the water in a truly humbling natural spectacle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and unwind with a private beach massage for two — a therapist comes directly to your beachfront location for a 90-minute relaxation massage with the sound of the ocean as your soundtrack.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — this time with a stargazing extension into the evening. As darkness falls, anchor in the middle of the ocean far from light pollution and marvel at the Milky Way with a sky map provided by the crew. Toast the moment with aged Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Hearty pre-excursion breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — full English breakfast, fresh juices, Maldivian tuna curry with roshi, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the boat during the manta ray excursion — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruits, energy snacks, and chilled water
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner for two at the resort's private dining cave — a unique underground cave setting with candles, a curated five-course menu, and a dedicated personal chef and butler

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are most reliable between November and April in the Maldives — March is an excellent time. Maintain a respectful distance from the mantas and follow the marine guide's instructions. No flash photography underwater.

day_by_day.morning: Luxury yacht half-day charter — explore the surrounding atolls aboard a private luxury yacht with a full crew. Snorkel at two exclusive reef sites, sunbathe on the yacht's deck, and enjoy the freedom of the open ocean in absolute style.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby uninhabited island — anchor offshore and wade to the pristine white sand beach. Explore the lush interior, collect sea glass, and enjoy the sensation of having an entire island entirely to yourselves for a few magical hours.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxing evening. Enjoy cocktails at the overwater bar as the sun sets, then attend the resort's weekly cultural performance featuring traditional Maldivian bodu beru drumming and dance before a leisurely dinner.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast on the yacht — continental spread with fresh fruits, pastries, smoked salmon, and freshly brewed coffee served on the yacht's deck as you set sail
meals.lunch: Gourmet lunch on the yacht — fresh sashimi, grilled seafood skewers, tropical salads, and chilled rosé wine
meals.dinner: Resort's seafood restaurant — fresh whole grilled lobster, garlic butter prawns, Maldivian coconut fish curry, and a shared passion fruit panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: The luxury yacht charter is a premium add-on — confirm pricing and availability with the resort concierge at check-in. The bodu beru cultural performance is typically held weekly; confirm the schedule with the resort upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Slow, indulgent morning — sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed, and spend time together in your private villa pool. Reflect on the journey so far and simply be present in one of the world's most beautiful places.
day_by_day.afternoon: Personalized jewelry-making workshop — join a local Maldivian artisan at the resort for a private workshop creating handcrafted shell and coral-inspired jewelry as a keepsake of your honeymoon. A deeply personal and creative experience.
day_by_day.evening: Penultimate romantic dinner — the resort arranges a special overwater deck dinner with floating candles, flower arrangements, and a personalized menu designed around your preferences. A dedicated chef and butler serve a six-course meal as the stars reflect on the water below.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — eggs any style, smoked salmon, fresh pastries, tropical fruit, Champagne, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch — mezze platter, fresh hummus, grilled halloumi, pita bread, and tropical iced teas
meals.dinner: Bespoke overwater deck private dinner — personalized six-course menu with your favorite dishes curated by the executive chef, paired with a premium wine selection chosen by the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: The jewelry workshop should be booked through the concierge 24 hours in advance. The overwater private dinner is an ideal occasion to recreate or celebrate a special moment from your honeymoon — inform the resort of any preferences, dietary needs, or surprises you may wish to arrange.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite reef spots from throughout the trip for one last underwater encounter. Take time to photograph the marine life, say farewell to the turtles and rays, and soak in the beauty of the coral gardens one final time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxury shopping and souvenir experience — visit the resort's boutique for handcrafted Maldivian souvenirs, premium local handicrafts, and keepsakes. Spend the late afternoon packing, organizing, and enjoying one last villa jacuzzi session with Champagne.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — a celebratory meal to mark the end of your honeymoon. The resort's executive chef presents a chef's table experience with a personalized menu, wine pairing, and a custom honeymoon dessert with a handwritten message.

meals.breakfast: Final floating breakfast in the villa pool — a lavish spread of all your favorite breakfast items from throughout the trip, curated by your butler
meals.lunch: Casual farewell beach lunch — grilled fish and chips, fresh coconut, tropical juices, and ice cream at the beach club
meals.dinner: Chef's table farewell dinner — an eight-course gastronomic journey featuring the finest ingredients, paired with a curated wine flight, and ending with a personalized honeymoon cake

day_by_day.notes: Request a personalized honeymoon certificate or memory book from the resort — many luxury Maldivian resorts offer this as a complimentary farewell gift. Pack carefully and leave out clothes for the next morning's departure. Confirm departure transfer times with the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Walk barefoot on the sand, take photographs, and take a moment to absorb every detail of this paradise before departing. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Your dedicated butler assists with luggage and departure formalities. Board your private seaplane or luxury speedboat transfer back to Malé International Airport, carrying memories of an extraordinary 13-day honeymoon in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Malé — board your return flight home, hearts full and souls deeply rested from one of the world's most romantic destinations.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a generous buffet and à la carte selection at the main restaurant, featuring everything from fresh tropical fruits and pastries to eggs Benedict and Maldivian specialties
meals.lunch: Light airport lunch at Malé's premium departure lounge or a quick bite before boarding
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the seaplane or speedboat transfer and airport check-in formalities. Exchange contact information with your resort butler and leave a review to honor the exceptional service received. Carry all underwater camera memory cards, jewelry, and fragile souvenirs in your carry-on luggage.
